core.item: ESP32 dev board (x2, one per hand)
core.product: Freenove ESP32 Development Board ESP32 Kit (2 Pack)
core.notes: One 2-pack covers both hands ($13.98/board). ESP32-WROOM, 4.4* (527), well documented.

core.product: Deegoo-FPV MG996R Metal Gear Digital Servo, 4-Pack
core.notes: 12 metal-gear standard servos, ~12 kg-cm @6V, $8.81/ea, 4.5* (1,182). Fits stock InMoov forearm. Showed 'only 6 left' - fallback: Aideepen MG996R 6-pack x2 (see Alternatives).
Adafruit-layout clone, works with Adafruit PWM library on ESP32. One board per hand matches 1-ESP32-per-hand; a single board (16 ch) could drive all 10 servos but would tie both hands to one ESP32.

core.item: Servo power supply (x2, one per hand)
core.product: SHNITPWR 3.5-12V Adjustable 10A 120W Power Supply w/ LCD
core.notes: Set to 6V. 10A = 5 MG996R running + 2-3 stalled (~2.5A stall each). LCD guards against accidental 12V. 4.3* (216). Servos NEVER on ESP32 5V pin; tie grounds.

core.product: 20 PCS Female DC 5.5x2.1mm Barrel to Screw Terminal
core.notes: Connects PSU to PCA9685 V+ terminal. Small jacks run warm near 10A - cutting the plug and screwing wire in is safer.
InMoov-class braid, low stretch; 100m is far more than both hands need. 4.5* (7.7K). Price for 50lb/100m variant.

core.product: Swpeet 150pc Stainless Extension Spring Assortment (15 sizes x 10)
core.notes: 10 of each size, so 10 matching springs per size for 10 fingers, lets you tune return force. 4.6* (111).

core.product: ELEGOO 120pc 20cm Dupont Wire (40 M-F / 40 M-M / 40 F-F)
core.notes: Signal/I2C wiring ESP32<->PCA9685. 4.7* (14.8K). One kit covers both hands.
Forearm servos to PCA9685 headers. Free shipping but slow (est. Oct 20-Nov 9); Prime alt in Alternatives.
18AWG handles the 10A servo bus; Dupont wire (24AWG) must not carry servo power. 4.5* (438).

optional.item: Fingertip force sensors (x2, proof of concept)
optional.notes: One per hand (e.g. index finger) on an ESP32 ADC pin via 10k divider. Qty-1 price break $10.43; qty 10 drops to $9.02/ea ($90.19) if you want all fingertips. DigiKey shipping for small orders NOT verified (free over $100 CAD). Amazon clones have 1 review - avoid.

alternatives.product: Miuzei MG90S Metal Gear Micro Servo, 10-Pack
alternatives.notes: Saves $65.67 vs MG996R, but only ~2 kg-cm and micro size: needs a remixed (non-stock) InMoov forearm. 4.5* (784).
12 servos for $79.98. Fallback if Deegoo sells out. Price from search results page. 4.3* (123).
~20 kg-cm, stronger grip; $197.97 for 12 (+$92 vs core). Search results price. 4.6* (47).
One board can run all 10 servos, but then one ESP32 drives both hands. 4.3* (222).

alternatives.item: Power - ONE supply for both hands
alternatives.notes: Saves ~$34 but max ~5.75V (less torque), single point of failure, exposed mains terminals need a cover. Needs AC cord below. 4.5* (182).
Only with the single-PSU option. Search results price.
Only 4 per size - not enough matching springs for 10 fingers.
$9.02/ea at qty 10; one per fingertip on both hands.
